one_line: Product in use in frame one, a name label throughout, one job shown twice, the tip held to the end.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 stacked Giotto be-bè tubs, a pink dough disc, a name label at the top. Voice (transcript) and text: "כך אני משתמשת בבצק משחק (המושלם!) של ג'יאוטו". 0:01 a child's hand presses the dough.
q1_hook.why: The product, a stated purpose and a named professional are in the first frame, said and written together (H1, H6, T3), and a hand moves by 0:01 (E1). "How I use" is a clear promise, though the hook gives a method, not a problem or a result (H2).

beats.what: Tubs and dough; text "כדי לעודד תפיסה חשבונית וכתיבת ספרות"; a child's hand presses dough
A page in a plastic sleeve with "5" and "7"; "בעזרת שמרדף פשוט... יצרתי לוח מחיק"
A marker-drawn sum; a flat dough disc beside each number; the child presses holes
beats.why: The core method in one frame

beats.what: The child counts the holes and writes the result; an adult hand wipes the sleeve clean
beats.why: Shows writing and that it can be reused

beats.what: A new sum, "4 + 4", four holes in each disc
beats.why: Repeats the method on a new sum

beats.what: "ממליצה לכתוב בראש הדף את סרגל המספרים"; the child writes an 8
beats.why: The tip promised in the caption

beats.what: "מוזמנים לעקוב לעוד המון תכנים מפתחים" over the child writing
beats.why: Follow ask on the last second

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption: "אל תפספסו את הטיפ החשוב בסוף" (a loop to the end), "שלכם בכל שאלה" (questions welcome). On screen at 0:26, "מוזמנים לעקוב". No comment, send or save ask.
q2_flow.why: A caption that holds the main tip to the end gives a reason to stay (H5, R4). One method shown twice, with a new sum, means no step is wasted (R3, R1). The tip arrives in the last seconds, and it ends right after it. 27 s fits a single demo (R2).

q3_cta.what: On screen 0:26 to 0:27: "מוזמנים לעקוב לעוד המון תכנים מפתחים". Caption: "את מוצרי Giotto be-bè ניתן לרכוש באתר סופרקיט" and "שלכם בכל שאלה". Nothing spoken.
q3_cta.why: A single follow ask after the value is light (C1, C7). It is shown, not said, and shown for under a second at the end, with text low in the frame (C6). The buying route is in the caption only, with no link.

q4_shown.what: Stacked Giotto be-bè tubs in frame at 0:00 and in the corner of most shots; a child's hand pressing holes in dough on a sleeved page; the sum, the result in marker, a wipe-clean. A name and role label at the top. No face.
q4_shown.why: The dough is handled by 0:01 (S1) and does a real job, so it is part of the action (K5). The label gives authority from frame one (S6). Brand tubs stay in frame, a light pulse (H3). Hands only, no child's face (S4, S5).

q5_edit.what: 8 shots in 26.8 s, about 3.4 s each; straight cuts at 1.9, 5.7, 12.7, 16.3, 18.3 s; mostly static close-ups. No speed changes. Voice from 0:00 to 0:26 with subtitles line by line. An adult hand wipes the board at 0:16.
q5_edit.why: A cut at 1.9 s opens with motion (E1), and cuts of 2 to 5 s in one scene hold the pace (E2). Voice with synced subtitles works muted or with sound (E4). It ends right after the last tip (E8).

q6_topic.what: Using play dough and a wipe-clean sleeve to practise addition and writing digits before first grade; serves a parent preparing a child for school.
q6_topic.why: Preparing for first grade is a real parent concern and the hashtag names it (K6, K7). A simple home activity from a therapist is modest and checkable (K4). The mood is calm and instructional, with no high-arousal peak (K1).

q7_filmed.what: Phone propped at an angle over a wooden table: a medium shot of the tubs, then close-ups of a sleeved page with big numbers, a child's hand, a marker, and an adult's hand wiping; warm window light.
q7_filmed.why: A close top-down view with hands puts the viewer in the seat (F5). Numbers and dough fill the frame, so the sum reads on a phone (F4). All live, homemade and sharp (F8, F7).

q8_text.on_screen: A small label at the top throughout, "מיכל שטורם מרפאה בעיסוק", with a crayon logo at 0:00 to 0:01. White subtitles with a dark outline, no box, two lines, about 70% down: "כך אני משתמשת בבצק משחק (המושלם!) של ג'יאוטו" (0:00), "הילד מסמן בבצק שקעים" (0:13), "ממליצה לכתוב בראש הדף את סרגל המספרים" (0:22), "מוזמנים לעקוב לעוד המון תכנים מפתחים" (0:26).
q8_text.caption: "אל תפספסו את הטיפ החשוב בסוף💫". About 26 words: where to buy, a sign-off with her name and role, 4 hashtags, one odd (#holhamoed26_ii). No disclosure line.
q8_text.why: A headline in the first second states the use (T3), and the subtitles follow the voice line by line, working muted (T1, T2). They sit in the lower band, 2 to 4 s each (T4, T5). The caption opens with a hook line, with few search words (T7). No partnership word (T8).

weak_points: No partnership wording although Giotto is a co-author; the follow ask lasts about a second; subtitles in the lower band; the tip is only readable at 0:22 to 0:26; one stray hashtag.
lumebook_takeaway: Film one page of the book top-down, hands only, with a name and role label in every frame, and hold the best tip for the last 4 seconds.
not_verified: Whether the voice is hers. Music. Whether she is paid or gifted by Giotto (co-author listed, no partnership wording). The dough's price. Corrections to coded file: the "tip at the end" is the number-line advice at 0:22 to 0:26, which the caption points to; the index counts 8 shots, matching.
